text: Evening. Childminder here, got a wee lad of 6 in tonight while his mammy's on a night shift. His temp's 39.9, took it under his arm then again in his ear to check. He's been greetin aboot his ear, keeps pullin at the left one and says it's sair. No fits or shaking or anythin like that, he's no been jerkin at all. Just wantin to ken whit I should be doin wi him the night and if he needs seen.
